name: tiered_remediation_cost_capped_credit
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local compliance policy. A firm has {F} open audit findings. Remediation cost is tiered: each of the first {B} findings costs {C1} USD; each finding beyond the first {B} costs {C2} USD. If the firm has {B} or fewer findings, only the first tier applies. Gross cost is the sum of both tiers. An early-closure credit of {K} USD per finding is earned for the {E} findings closed early, giving an uncapped credit. The applied credit is the uncapped credit capped at {P} percent of gross cost, and it is granted only when gross cost is at least {M} USD; if gross cost is below {M} USD the applied credit is zero. Net remediation cost equals gross cost minus the applied credit. Report gross cost, uncapped credit, applied credit, and net cost.

slots.description: Gross tiered remediation cost before any credit.
Early-closure credit before applying cap or threshold.
Credit actually applied after cap and threshold gating.

program:
def solve():
    F = P["F"]
    B = P["B"]
    C1 = P["C1"]
    C2 = P["C2"]
    E = P["E"]
    K = P["K"]
    Pc = P["P"]
    M = P["M"]
    tier1_count = F if F <= B else B
    tier2_count = F - tier1_count
    gross = tier1_count * C1 + tier2_count * C2
    uncapped = E * K
    cap = gross * Pc / 100
    if gross >= M:
        applied = uncapped if uncapped <= cap else cap
    else:
        applied = 0
    net = gross - applied
    return {
        "final": net,
        "gross_cost": gross,
        "uncapped_credit": uncapped,
        "applied_credit": applied
    }
